role_archetype.rationale: The role combines a Lead Data Analyst identity and hands-on analytical tools with a Legal Tech cyber incident review context, while allowing a capability-led alternative without prior domain experience.

evidence_signals.name: Domain-led candidates are the strongest target: Lead or Senior Data Analyst identity, hands-on SQL and Python, and Cyber Incident Review and/or Data Breach Analysis experience.
Domain-led candidates may be located anywhere in India, including remote resources, and do not require Power Query.

Capability-led candidates are an acceptable alternative without prior cyber incident review domain experience, but must have a strong Data Analyst background, Lead level, at least six years of experience, hands-on SQL and Python, and working knowledge of Power Query.
Capability-led candidates must be located in Hyderabad or Pune; India-wide eligibility applies only to the domain-led path.
Lead level may be demonstrated through people leadership or technical leadership.
Hands-on use of SQL and Python for data querying, data analysis, automation, and reporting.
For capability-led candidates, working knowledge of Power Query for data transformation, preparation, and reporting is required; this is a lower proficiency expectation than hands-on SQL and Python.
The team performs Cyber Incident Review and Data Breach Analysis within a Legal Tech / Legal Solutions environment, rather than cybersecurity operations.
Background in Legal Tech, LPO, Legal Solutions, legal-services technology, Data Breach Analysis, or related evidence-backed environments.

Cybersecurity, SOC, Security Operations, Security Analyst, SIEM, Threat Detection, security incident response, and other cybersecurity operations experience do not substitute for Cyber Incident Review or Data Breach Analysis experience.
A reference to cyber or incidents alone does not demonstrate the relevant review domain.
Experience performing review, quality assurance, compliance, audit, or security monitoring activities.
Experience managing cyber incident reviews, breach investigations, or data privacy review workflows.
Solid understanding of cybersecurity review processes, distinct from conventional security operations.
Lead, mentor, coach, support, and provide ongoing feedback to analysts while coordinating operational workflows.
Deliver high-quality review services and quality-control work while meeting productivity, security standards, protocol, and compliance objectives.
Review, analyse, and interpret large datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and potential security risks.
Collaborate with technology, security, legal, compliance, and business stakeholders to address review findings and support remediation.
Prepare management reports, dashboards, and performance metrics to support operational and business decisions.
Maintain accurate documentation, procedures, audit trails, and quality records in accordance with organizational and client requirements.
Partner with the Review Manager on business objectives, administrative activities, resource planning, workflow priorities, and team coordination.
Drive continuous improvement in operational efficiency, quality, and compliance outcomes.
Strong analytical capabilities and attention to detail.
An equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience is acceptable.
